cards.image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers beside a simple desk. One is seated near an open laptop on the LEFT; the other stands at center, making a friendly open-palm gesture. On RIGHT foreground of the desk is ONE large freestanding circular analog TIMER with a clear top knob, round face and two plain hands. Entire timer and its small base unobstructed. No numbers or letters on the dial, no decorative symbols.
